label: 藏不住的得意
beats: 屈膝蓄势，小幅雀跃，双手握拳庆祝，害羞别过脸，长尾轻摆复位
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A production sprite atlas of EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 sequential key drawings of one continuous 9-second animation, row-major. Transparent background. SAME adult dragon princess as reference: silver-white long hair, ivory horns, purple eyes, lavender wings and long tail, ornate white/lilac rose full-length dress, SAME costume accessories sleeves corset hem and shoes in every frame. Proud but caring tsundere personality. Absolutely no outfit or proportion changes, no apron/crown, no labels/grid/watermark. Full body wings tail horn tips shoes entirely visible in EVERY drawing. Leave clear TRANSPARENT SPACE between all 16 figures; fixed camera scale, no zoom, no whole-body bobbing. Detailed clean anime cel art. Generate 16 DIFFERENT progressive articulated drawings of ONLY this action, SMALL natural changes between adjacent frames, preparation/main movement/follow-through/recovery, first and last compatible for looping: 藏不住的得意。动作设计：屈膝蓄势，小幅雀跃，双手握拳庆祝，害羞别过脸，长尾轻摆复位。Hair, sleeves, skirt, wings and tail have independent delayed motion; hands/arms/face must actually move. Keep costumes fully visible and complete with empty padding around each figure.
method: imagegen articulated key drawings; FFmpeg motion-compensated interpolation to 24fps; transparent GIF encoding
paletteSource: opaque pixels of the original key drawings; excludes matte spill
